bundles.title: Spec-driven workflow
bundles.description: A thin spec-driven workflow for Power BI: survey an existing or published report (levantamiento), or start a new one, then spec, tasks, build and verify with written, approved steps. Leans on the Microsoft and data-goblin skills rather than repeating them.

bundles.title: Tableau authoring
bundles.description: Drives Tableau Desktop 2026.3 through its External Client API with the tableu MCP server: data sources and .hyper extracts, fields, calculations, parameters, sets, sheets, filters, formatting, dashboards, navigation buttons, filter/parameter/set actions and stories, each validated by Tableau and linted against its best practices. Includes a tableau-author subagent and /setup.

skillSummaries.tableau-authoring: Drives Tableau Desktop 2026.3 through its External Client API with the tableu MCP server: data sources and .hyper extracts, fields, calculations, parameters, sets, sheets, filters, formatting, dashboards, navigation buttons, filter/parameter/set actions and stories, each validated by Tableau and linted against its best practices. Ten references, one per topic, map each operation to the XML Desktop writes for the same menu, context-menu or dialog command (measured). Includes a tableau-author subagent and /setup.
skillSummaries.tableau-data-model: The data model under the sheets: connections, relationships versus joins (and why totals double), data source filters, .hyper extracts, field properties as Desktop writes them, calculations, LOD and table calcs, and their performance rules.
skillSummaries.tableau-design: How Tableau work is structured per Tableau's official guidance: site, project, collection, workbook, worksheets, dashboards and stories; which chart answers which question; tiled fixed-size dashboard layout with 2-3 views and KPIs first; a pre-delivery checklist mapped to tableu operations. References: design brief, dashboard archetypes measured on Tableau's own dashboards, color (with Tableau's palettes), typography, accessibility, anti-patterns.

bundles.title: Tableau spec-driven workflow
bundles.description: Survey a Tableau workbook with Info and Lint evidence or start a new one, then spec, tasks, a build where every task runs inside a transaction, and verification with exported images and Desktop's warnings.

bundles.title: Tableau guardrails
bundles.description: Lints every .twb/.twbx the agent edits against Tableau's best practices and blocks on errors, so they are fixed before moving on. Runs as a Claude Code or Copilot CLI plugin hook; needs uv.
hooks: tableu lint after any .twb or .twbx edit; errors block, warnings come back as context

bundles.title: Looker Studio authoring
bundles.description: Edits a Looker Studio / Data Studio report open in Edge or Chrome over CDP with the looker-studio MCP server: safe copies, layout, fields, source calculated fields, components, controls, filters, themes, pages and declarative report specs, with diagnosis and a UX audit. An authoring skill with one reference per topic and a CLI-to-MCP index that a check keeps in step with the server, six best-practice skills, a looker-studio-author subagent and /setup.

skillSummaries.ls-authoring: How to build with the looker-studio MCP server and its ls-studio CLI: safe copies, components and templates, fields and source calculated fields, controls and filters, pages, themes, report settings, report specs and verification, with one reference per topic and an index of every tool and CLI command that a check keeps in step with the server.
skillSummaries.ls-depuracion-errores: Debugging Looker Studio / Data Studio reports: programmatic detection, basic hygiene and a catalogue of errors (incomplete or invalid chart configuration, broken fields, credentials, quotas, blends) with their fixes.
skillSummaries.ls-diseno-layout: Report design and layout: layout mode, canvas size, grid and alignment, visual hierarchy, density, colour, typography, accessibility and mobile, with four page archetypes and the measured contrast of the theme library.
skillSummaries.ls-kpi-scorecards: KPI rows and scorecards: how many cards per row, Setup and Style options, comparison periods, compact numbers, change colours and conditional formatting.
skillSummaries.ls-migracion: Migrations: Universal Analytics to GA4, replacing a report's data source, what breaks, the copy-first workflow and moving to Data Studio Pro.
skillSummaries.ls-modelo-datos: The data model: embedded versus reusable sources, credentials, dimensions and metrics, field ids versus display names, calculated fields, parameters, blends and naming conventions.
skillSummaries.ls-rendimiento: Performance: official limits, components and queries per page, cache and freshness, Extract Data, BigQuery and BI Engine, blends, filters, cardinality and the GA4 token quota.

bundles.title: Looker Studio spec-driven workflow
bundles.description: Survey a Looker Studio report with diagnose evidence or start a new one, then a spec materialised as a declarative report spec, tasks, a build that dry-runs every apply first, and verification in view mode.

bundles.title: Looker Studio guardrails
bundles.description: Lints every *.spec.json the agent edits and blocks on errors; when a browser answers on the CDP port it also shows the apply --dry-run plan. Runs as a Claude Code or Copilot CLI plugin hook; needs Node 20+.
hooks: report-spec lint after any *.spec.json edit; errors block
apply --dry-run plan when a browser is on the CDP port

bundles.title: PBIP guardrails
bundles.description: Checks PBIR structure, TMDL syntax and report-to-model binding automatically after every edit, with PBIR and TMDL format references. Ships native validators for macOS, Linux and Windows; its hooks need jq, and silently do nothing without it.
hooks: PBIR structure and schema, after any edit inside a .Report folder

bundles.title: Live model guardrails
bundles.description: Connects to an open Power BI Desktop model and checks DAX references, measure metadata and referential integrity as the agent changes it. Windows only, with Power BI Desktop running.
hooks: DAX references resolve to real tables, columns and measures
new measures carry a display folder, description and format string
referential integrity after relationship or key-column changes

bundles.title: Semantic model craft
bundles.description: DAX, Power Query, naming conventions, lineage analysis and refresh, with an auditor agent that reviews a whole model.

bundles.title: Report craft
bundles.description: Report creation and design, theme JSON, report review and pbir-cli, with reviewer agents for Deneb, SVG, R and Python visuals.

bundles.title: Tabular Editor
bundles.description: Best Practice Analyzer rules, C# scripting and Tabular Editor 2/3 CLI automation.
